services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Catch more state water snapper than any other guide in the state of Texas! We are Fully licensed, hold a Texas Parks & Wildlife Guides License & United States Coast Guard Captain's License. Wade fishing, this is the technique where we get in the water, and walk the shallow grass flats and sand pockets. This allows us to meticulously work an area for fish, without the footprint of a boat to scare them off. While wade fishing we can ether target the fish using live bait or artificial.
